# NEW 2026-11-21 v9.7 Theme System 2.0 Overhaul (oe_t2_). Generated by gen_theme_v97.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# Any scope. Adjusts Pillars Imperial Authority safely within 0..100.
oe_t2_change_auth = {
    if = {
        limit = { exists = international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars }
        international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars = {
            if = {
                limit = { has_variable = oe_pillars_authority }
                change_variable = { name = oe_pillars_authority add = $amount$ }
                clamp_variable = { name = oe_pillars_authority min = 0 max = 100 }
            }
        }
    }
}

# Location scope. Instantly constructs a free jurisdiction post matching $owner$'s subject type.
oe_t2_construct_matching_post = {
    if = {
        limit = { $owner$ = { is_subject_type = oe_empire_theme_naval } }
        construct_building = { building_type = building_type:oe_byz_theme_naval_post owner = $owner$ instant = yes cost_multiplier = 0 cost_multiplier_reason = "game_concept_event" }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { $owner$ = { is_subject_type = oe_empire_theme_administrative } }
        construct_building = { building_type = building_type:oe_byz_theme_administrative_post owner = $owner$ instant = yes cost_multiplier = 0 cost_multiplier_reason = "game_concept_event" }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { $owner$ = { is_subject_type = oe_empire_theme_frontier } }
        construct_building = { building_type = building_type:oe_byz_theme_frontier_post owner = $owner$ instant = yes cost_multiplier = 0 cost_multiplier_reason = "game_concept_event" }
    }
    else = {
        construct_building = { building_type = building_type:oe_byz_theme_system owner = $owner$ instant = yes cost_multiplier = 0 cost_multiplier_reason = "game_concept_event" }
    }
}

# Location scope; scope:oe_t2_split_parent is the co-administering theme whose post must be removed.
oe_t2_destroy_parent_post = {
    if = { limit = { has_building = building_type:oe_byz_theme_system } destroy_building_forcefully = "building(building_type:oe_byz_theme_system|scope:oe_t2_split_parent)" }
    if = { limit = { has_building = building_type:oe_byz_theme_naval_post } destroy_building_forcefully = "building(building_type:oe_byz_theme_naval_post|scope:oe_t2_split_parent)" }
    if = { limit = { has_building = building_type:oe_byz_theme_administrative_post } destroy_building_forcefully = "building(building_type:oe_byz_theme_administrative_post|scope:oe_t2_split_parent)" }
    if = { limit = { has_building = building_type:oe_byz_theme_frontier_post } destroy_building_forcefully = "building(building_type:oe_byz_theme_frontier_post|scope:oe_t2_split_parent)" }
    if = { limit = { has_building = building_type:oe_byz_theme_italian_post } destroy_building_forcefully = "building(building_type:oe_byz_theme_italian_post|scope:oe_t2_split_parent)" }
    if = { limit = { has_building = building_type:oe_byz_theme_latin_post } destroy_building_forcefully = "building(building_type:oe_byz_theme_latin_post|scope:oe_t2_split_parent)" }
}

# Theme scope; scope:oe_t2_absorb_seat is the seat location of historical region $region_id$.
# Co-administers historical region $region_id$ without altering the 39 region IDs.
oe_t2_absorb_region_into_theme = {
    save_scope_as = oe_t2_absorber
    set_variable = { name = oe_t2_absorbed_region value = $region_id$ }
    if = {
        limit = { exists = scope:oe_t2_absorb_seat }
        set_variable = { name = oe_t2_absorbed_seat value = scope:oe_t2_absorb_seat }
        scope:oe_t2_absorb_seat = { set_variable = oe_t2_merged_center }
    }
    c:BYZ = {
        every_owned_location = {
            limit = {
                var:oe_theme_region ?= $region_id$
                NOT = { oe_theme_location_occupied_trigger = yes }
            }
            oe_t2_construct_matching_post = { owner = scope:oe_t2_absorber }
        }
    }
    set_variable = oe_theme_tiers_dirty
}

# BYZ scope; scope:recipient = minor theme to absorb, scope:target = receiving loyal theme.
oe_t2_do_consolidate_theme = {
    scope:recipient = {
        if = { limit = { exists = capital } capital = { save_scope_as = oe_t2_old_seat } }
        ruler ?= { save_scope_as = oe_t2_former_strat }
        save_scope_value_as = { name = oe_t2_xfer_gold value = oe_t2_half_gold }
        save_scope_value_as = { name = oe_t2_xfer_mp value = oe_t2_half_manpower }
        every_owned_foreign_building_location = {
            limit = { has_owner = yes owner ?= c:BYZ }
            oe_t2_construct_matching_post = { owner = scope:target }
        }
        every_army = { change_unit_owner = scope:target }
        every_navy = { change_unit_owner = scope:target }
    }
    scope:target = {
        add_gold = scope:oe_t2_xfer_gold
        add_manpower = scope:oe_t2_xfer_mp
        if = {
            limit = { scope:recipient = { has_variable = oe_theme_region_id } }
            set_variable = { name = oe_t2_absorbed_region value = scope:recipient.var:oe_theme_region_id }
        }
        if = {
            limit = { exists = scope:oe_t2_old_seat }
            set_variable = { name = oe_t2_absorbed_seat value = scope:oe_t2_old_seat }
            scope:oe_t2_old_seat = { set_variable = oe_t2_merged_center }
        }
        set_variable = oe_theme_tiers_dirty
    }
    scope:oe_t2_former_strat ?= {
        if = {
            limit = { is_alive = yes }
            move_country = c:BYZ
            reset_ruler_title = {}
        }
    }
    c:BYZ = {
        annex_country = { country = scope:recipient reason = Diplomatic transfer = yes }
    }
}

# Theme scope (the co-administering parent theme). Splits off its absorbed historical region as a standalone theme.
oe_t2_do_split_theme = {
    save_scope_as = oe_t2_split_parent
    if = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_t2_absorbed_region has_variable = oe_t2_absorbed_seat }
        var:oe_t2_absorbed_seat = { save_scope_as = oe_t2_split_seat }
        every_owned_foreign_building_location = {
            limit = {
                has_owner = yes
                owner ?= c:BYZ
                var:oe_theme_region ?= scope:oe_t2_split_parent.var:oe_t2_absorbed_region
            }
            oe_t2_destroy_parent_post = yes
        }
        remove_variable = oe_t2_absorbed_region
        remove_variable = oe_t2_absorbed_seat
        oe_ts_recent_loy = { amount = 5 }
        set_variable = oe_theme_tiers_dirty
        if = {
            limit = { exists = scope:oe_t2_split_seat }
            scope:oe_t2_split_seat = {
                remove_variable = oe_t2_merged_center
                if = {
                    limit = { has_owner = yes owner ?= c:BYZ }
                    save_scope_as = oe_theme_seat
                    c:BYZ = { oe_theme_found_at_seat = yes }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

# BYZ scope; scope:recipient & scope:target are two themes swapping their Strategoi cleanly.
oe_t2_do_rotate_strategoi = {
    scope:recipient = { ruler = { save_scope_as = oe_t2_gen_a } }
    scope:target = { ruler = { save_scope_as = oe_t2_gen_b } }
    scope:oe_t2_gen_a = { move_country = c:BYZ }
    scope:oe_t2_gen_b = { move_country = c:BYZ }
    scope:oe_t2_gen_a = { move_country = scope:target }
    scope:target = { set_new_ruler = scope:oe_t2_gen_a }
    scope:oe_t2_gen_b = { move_country = scope:recipient }
    scope:recipient = { set_new_ruler = scope:oe_t2_gen_b }
    scope:recipient = {
        set_variable = { name = oe_theme_tenure value = 0 }
        if = { limit = { exists = ruler } set_variable = { name = oe_theme_strategos value = ruler } }
        oe_ts_recent_loy = { amount = 8 }
        oe_tg_refresh_house = yes
        add_cooldown = { type = oe_t2_rotate_cd years = 5 }
    }
    scope:target = {
        set_variable = { name = oe_theme_tenure value = 0 }
        if = { limit = { exists = ruler } set_variable = { name = oe_theme_strategos value = ruler } }
        oe_ts_recent_loy = { amount = 8 }
        oe_tg_refresh_house = yes
        add_cooldown = { type = oe_t2_rotate_cd years = 5 }
    }
}

# BYZ scope; scope:recipient is a loyal veteran theme whose Strategos receives a Triumph and Senate retirement.
oe_t2_do_triumph_retire = {
    add_gold = -120
    oe_t2_change_auth = { amount = 5 } # Invests 3 Authority to reap +8 Authority (net +5)
    add_army_tradition = 10
    add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_t2_imperial_triumph_splendor years = 5 mode = replace }
    scope:recipient = {
        ruler ?= { save_scope_as = oe_t2_veteran }
        oe_ts_replace_strategos = yes
        set_variable = { name = oe_theme_tenure value = 0 }
        if = { limit = { exists = ruler } set_variable = { name = oe_theme_strategos value = ruler } }
        oe_ts_recent_loy = { amount = 10 }
        oe_tg_refresh_house = yes
        add_cooldown = { type = oe_t2_triumph_cd years = 10 }
    }
    scope:oe_t2_veteran ?= {
        if = {
            limit = { is_alive = yes }
            add_character_modifier = { modifier = oe_t2_senate_triumphator years = -1 mode = replace }
        }
    }
}

# BYZ scope; scope:recipient is the theme receiving an imperial marriage tie.
oe_t2_do_imperial_marriage = {
    oe_t2_change_auth = { amount = -5 }
    add_prestige = -10
    if = {
        limit = { scope:recipient = { ruler ?= { is_alive = yes is_married = no } } }
        scope:recipient = { ruler = { save_scope_as = oe_t2_strat_ruler } }
        if = {
            limit = {
                any_character = {
                    is_alive = yes
                    is_adult = yes
                    is_ruler = no
                    is_heir = no
                    is_consort = no
                    is_regent = no
                    is_married = no
                    is_eligible_for_marriage = yes
                    NOT = { oe_bells_protected_thinker = yes }
                    can_marry_character = scope:oe_t2_strat_ruler
                }
            }
            random_character = {
                limit = {
                    is_alive = yes
                    is_adult = yes
                    is_ruler = no
                    is_heir = no
                    is_consort = no
                    is_regent = no
                    is_married = no
                    is_eligible_for_marriage = yes
                    NOT = { oe_bells_protected_thinker = yes }
                    can_marry_character = scope:oe_t2_strat_ruler
                }
                save_scope_as = oe_t2_royal_spouse
            }
            scope:oe_t2_royal_spouse ?= {
                move_country = scope:recipient
                marry_character = scope:oe_t2_strat_ruler
            }
        }
    }
    set_variable = { name = oe_t2_inlaw_tied years = 20 }
    scope:recipient = {
        add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_t2_imperial_inlaw_bond years = 20 mode = replace }
        oe_ts_recent_loy = { amount = 15 }
        add_cooldown = { type = oe_t2_marriage_cd years = 10 }
        if = {
            limit = { oe_tg_house_born = yes }
            oe_ti_house_inf = { amount = 60 }
        }
    }
}

# BYZ scope; scope:recipient receives Hereditary Command (hooks into oe_tg_hereditary).
oe_t2_do_confirm_hereditary = {
    oe_t2_change_auth = { amount = -8 }
    scope:recipient = {
        set_variable = oe_tg_hereditary
        add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_t2_hereditary_strategos years = 30 mode = replace }
        oe_ts_recent_loy = { amount = 10 }
    }
}

# BYZ scope (decision). Imperial Inspectorate across all active themes.
oe_t2_do_imperial_inspection = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_t2_inspect_cd years = 10 }
    every_subject = {
        limit = { oe_theme_member_trigger = yes NOT = { has_variable = oe_theme_revolt_now } }
        oe_theme_admin_init = yes
        if = {
            limit = { OR = { var:oe_theme_loyalty_band ?= 2 var:oe_theme_loyalty_band ?= 3 } }
            add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_t2_inspectorate_order years = 5 mode = replace }
            oe_ts_recent_loy = { amount = 5 }
        }
        else = {
            oe_ts_recent_loy = { amount = 8 }
        }
    }
}

# BYZ scope (decision). Revokes hereditary command from the most estranged hereditary theme (double Authority cost).
oe_t2_do_revoke_hereditary_one = {
    ordered_subject = {
        limit = { oe_theme_member_trigger = yes has_variable = oe_tg_hereditary }
        order_by = oe_t2_estrangement
        max = 1
        check_range_bounds = no
        remove_variable = oe_tg_hereditary
        if = {
            limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_t2_hereditary_strategos }
            remove_country_modifier = oe_t2_hereditary_strategos
        }
        oe_ts_recent_loy = { amount = -15 }
    }
}

# Theme scope (step 8 of oe_theme_dispatch_pulse; only called when var:oe_theme_loyalty < 35).
# Pre-revolt political crisis window: 20 <= oe_theme_loyalty < 35 (15+ months before < 20 armed revolt).
oe_t2_crisis_monthly = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            has_variable = oe_theme_loyalty
            var:oe_theme_loyalty >= 20
            var:oe_theme_loyalty < 35
            NOT = { has_variable = oe_t2_crisis_cd }
            NOT = { has_variable = oe_theme_revolt_now }
            country_exists = c:BYZ
            c:BYZ = {
                is_rebel_country = no
                NOT = { has_variable = oe_t2_crisis_global_cd }
            }
        }
        save_scope_as = oe_t2_crisis_lead
        set_variable = { name = oe_t2_crisis_cd years = 8 }
        if = {
            limit = {
                c:BYZ = {
                    NOT = { has_variable = oe_t2_petition_cd }
                    oe_t2_restless_theme_count >= 2
                }
            }
            c:BYZ = {
                set_variable = { name = oe_t2_petition_cd years = 8 }
                set_variable = { name = oe_t2_crisis_global_cd months = 12 }
                set_variable = { name = oe_t2_crisis_theme value = scope:oe_t2_crisis_lead }
                trigger_event_non_silently = oe_t2_crisis.2
            }
        }
        else = {
            c:BYZ = {
                set_variable = { name = oe_t2_crisis_global_cd months = 12 }
                set_variable = { name = oe_t2_crisis_theme value = scope:oe_t2_crisis_lead }
                trigger_event_non_silently = oe_t2_crisis.1
            }
        }
    }
}

# BYZ scope. Imperial Guard purge success / failure helpers for oe_t2_crisis.1 Option A.
oe_t2_crisis_purge_win = {
    var:oe_t2_crisis_theme ?= {
        oe_ts_replace_strategos = yes
        set_variable = { name = oe_theme_tenure value = 0 }
        if = { limit = { exists = ruler } set_variable = { name = oe_theme_strategos value = ruler } }
        set_variable = { name = oe_theme_loyalty value = 55 }
        set_variable = { name = oe_theme_loyalty_band value = 2 }
        remove_variable = oe_tg_hereditary
        if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_t2_hereditary_strategos } remove_country_modifier = oe_t2_hereditary_strategos }
        oe_tg_refresh_house = yes
    }
    every_subject = {
        limit = { oe_theme_member_trigger = yes NOT = { this = c:BYZ.var:oe_t2_crisis_theme } }
        oe_ts_recent_loy = { amount = 5 }
    }
}

oe_t2_crisis_purge_fail = {
    var:oe_t2_crisis_theme ?= {
        set_variable = { name = oe_theme_loyalty value = 15 }
        set_variable = { name = oe_theme_loyalty_band value = 0 }
    }
}

# BYZ scope. Loyal neighbour crackdown + rebel estate confiscation for oe_t2_crisis.1 Option C.
oe_t2_crisis_neighbor_crackdown = {
    var:oe_t2_crisis_theme ?= {
        if = {
            limit = { oe_tg_house_born = yes }
            oe_ti_house_inf = { amount = -80 }
            c:BYZ = {
                add_gold = 250
                set_variable = oe_t2_confiscated_house
            }
        }
        oe_ts_replace_strategos = yes
        set_variable = { name = oe_theme_tenure value = 0 }
        if = { limit = { exists = ruler } set_variable = { name = oe_theme_strategos value = ruler } }
        set_variable = { name = oe_theme_loyalty value = 50 }
        set_variable = { name = oe_theme_loyalty_band value = 2 }
        remove_variable = oe_tg_hereditary
        if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_t2_hereditary_strategos } remove_country_modifier = oe_t2_hereditary_strategos }
        oe_tg_refresh_house = yes
    }
    var:oe_t2_enforcer_theme ?= {
        add_gold = 100
        oe_ts_recent_loy = { amount = 10 }
    }
    trigger_event_non_silently = { id = oe_t2_crisis.3 days = 2 }
}

# BYZ scope. Clears crisis tracking variables once resolved.
oe_t2_crisis_clear_vars = {
    remove_variable = oe_t2_crisis_theme
    remove_variable = oe_t2_enforcer_theme
    remove_variable = oe_t2_confiscated_house
}
